summary: Well-known issues have prevented deployment of multicast on 802.11 (Wi-Fi) and other local wireless networks. This informational document describes limitations of wireless layer 2 multicast, the enhancement features specified by IETF and IEEE 802, and operational choices that improve performance, with recommendations.

eli5.summary: Sending one message to many devices over Wi-Fi works badly. This document explains why and offers tips to make it work better.
